owner_steering.interpretation: The checklist's documented mapping is not evidence that the current physical RES wire is present. The reset-read candidate therefore has no admissible hardware prerequisite yet.

required_human_action.power_state: Power the NUCLEO and FTS02 off before touching wires.
required_human_action.connect: FTS02 P9 pin 6 / T5 / RES -> NUCLEO CN10 pin 24 / PB1
required_human_action.visually_confirm: FTS02 P9 pin 5 / T4 / BUSY -> NUCLEO CN7 pin 3 / PC5
do_not_do: Do not touch, reseat, move, or remove the display FPC.

fail_closed_gate.continue_condition: A canonical Chinese aiw operator-prompt result explicitly confirms both RES connected and BUSY visually confirmed after power-off wiring work.
fail_closed_gate.failure_rule: Until that result exists, do not flash, reset, read, refresh, or otherwise contact the hardware.

checklist.documented_res_mapping: P9 pin 6 / T5 / RES -> CN10 pin 24 / PB1
checklist.documented_busy_mapping: P9 pin 5 / T4 / BUSY -> CN7 pin 3 / PC5

forbidden_claims: No claim that PB1/RES or PC5/BUSY is physically connected before the operator result.
No controller-read, waveform, visual, residue, temperature, production, or panel-identity acceptance.
No hardware candidate execution before both wiring prerequisites are confirmed.
